name: split-pane
title: Split Pane
description: Two panels with a shared, accessible resize handle. Dragging follows the pointer; keyboard resizing, collapse and restore use the library motion tokens. Content stays mounted when the layout changes direction.
example:
<SplitPane primary={<ProjectFiles />} secondary={<CodePreview />}
  primaryLabel="Project files" secondaryLabel="Code preview"
  value={size} onValueChange={setSize} minValue={22} maxValue={65}
  collapsible stackAt={520} height={340} />
